2608.16380.title: Synthetic Data Augmentation for Satellite-Based Analysis of Battle-Damaged Agricultural Fields in Ukraine
2608.16380.paper_summary: Monitoring war-induced damage to agricultural land in Ukraine is important for understanding threats to food security, environmental stability, and post-war recovery. However, the development of computer-vision systems for satellite-based damage analysis is limited by the scarcity of labeled imagery, especially for damaged agricultural fields. This work investigates synthetic data augmentation as a method for improving classification under limited and imbalanced training data. We train class-conditional Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) and Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM) architectures on real satellite images and use them to generate additional bombed and not-bombed agricultural-field samples. The generated images are used only for training augmentation, while all downstream evaluation is performed on an exclusively real test set. A Vision Transformer classifier is trained under multiple real and synthetic data configurations to measure the practical utility of each generative approach. The best configuration, based on balanced DDPM augmentation, improves accuracy from 84\% to 88\%, balanced accuracy from 67\% to 81\%, macro F1 from 65\% to 78\%, and recall for the underrepresented not-bombed class from 41\% to 69\%. These results demonstrate the potential of synthetic satellite imagery for data-scarce geospatial applications in war-affected regions.
2608.16380.paper_summary_zh: 監測烏克蘭因戰爭造成的農業用地損害對於理解食品安全、環境穩定性和戰後恢復的威脅至關重要。<lb/>然而，基於衛星的損害分析的計算機視覺系統的發展受到標記影像稀缺的限制，尤其是對於受損的農田。<lb/>本研究探討了合成數據增強作為在有限和不平衡訓練數據下改善分類的方法。<lb/>我們在真實衛星影像上訓練類條件生成對抗網絡（GAN）和去噪擴散概率模型（DDPM）架構，並利用它們生成額外的受炸和未受炸的農田樣本。<lb/>生成的影像僅用於訓練增強，而所有下游評估則僅在真實測試集上進行。<lb/>在多個真實和合成數據配置下訓練了一個視覺Transformer分類器，以測量每種生成方法的實際效用。<lb/>基於平衡的DDPM增強的最佳配置將準確率從84\%提高到88\%，平衡準確率從67\%提高到81\%，宏觀F1從65\%提高到78\%，以及對於代表性不足的未受炸類別的召回率從41\%提高到69\%。<lb/>這些結果展示了合成衛星影像在戰爭影響地區數據稀缺的地理空間應用中的潛力。
